commands.event: Upcoming events, and planning new ones.
commands.create: Plans an event with RSVP reactions.
commands.poll: Starts a poll with number reactions.

when.missing: I need a time and a title for that.
when.invalid: That's not a time I know. Try `fri 20:00`, `2026-11-02 19:30` or `in 3h`.
when.title: The event needs a title.
when.long: Keep the title under 200 characters and the description under 2,000.

noChannel: There is no event channel set up, and I cannot post here.
listEmpty: No events coming up. Quiet week.
alreadyOver: Event {number} is already {status, select, cancelled {cancelled} ended {over} other {{status}}}.

embed.repeats: {recurrence, select, daily {**Repeats** every day} weekly {**Repeats** every {weekday, select, mon {Monday} tue {Tuesday} wed {Wednesday} thu {Thursday} fri {Friday} sat {Saturday} sun {Sunday} other {{weekday}}}} other {**Repeats** every month on the {day, selectordinal, one {#st} two {#nd} few {#rd} other {#th}}}}
embed.hint: React with {going} if you're going, {maybe} for maybe, {no} if you can't make it.

reminderNote: {place, select, guild {{guild}. You said you're going.} other {You said you're going.}}

problems.question: I need a question for that.
problems.few: A poll needs at least two options.
problems.many: Ten options at most. There are only ten number reactions.
problems.long: Keep the question under 250 characters and each option under 100.
problems.duplicate: Two of the options are the same.

poll.multiple: Pick as many as you like.
poll.anonymous: Votes are anonymous. Your reaction disappears, your vote stays.
poll.toggle: React with the same number again to take it back.
poll.votersOpen: {voters, plural, =0 {No votes yet.} one {**# person** voted so far.} other {**# people** voted so far.}}
poll.votersClosed: {voters, plural, =0 {Nobody voted.} one {**# person** voted.} other {**# people** voted.}}
poll.winner: {result, select, none {Poll closed. Nobody voted on **{question}**.} one {Poll closed. **{winner}** wins with {votes, number} of {total, plural, one {# vote} other {# votes}}.} other {Poll closed. Tie between {winners} with {votes, plural, one {# vote} other {# votes}} each.}}
poll.receiptRemoved: Took back your vote for **{option}** on **{question}**.
poll.cardVoters: {voters, plural, one {# person} other {# people}} voted{multiple, select, yes {, several picks allowed} other {}}
poll.tooLong: A poll can run for 30 days at most.
poll.noChannel: I cannot post the poll here.
